title: ast.insert_at_anchor request
description: Locate a unique AST anchor in `path` via a Tree-Sitter query, then splice `content` into the file relative to that anchor. `position` picks the sibling/child slot. Reads and writes route through staged-fs (#1722) when `session_id` is supplied. Companion to `ast.apply_node`: where `apply_node` replaces a span, this primitive adds one.

query.description: Tree-Sitter S-expression query. Must declare at least one capture; the capture named by `target_capture` (default `anchor`) names the anchor. Single-capture queries are accepted regardless of capture name. The query MUST match exactly one node — multi-match returns `ambiguous`.

position.description: Where to splice relative to the anchor. `before`/`after` insert siblings at the anchor's indent depth. `first_child`/`last_child` insert inside the anchor (just past the opening or just before the closing delimiter) at the inferred child depth.

content.description: Text to insert. Re-indented to the target depth on each line unless `reindent` is false.

language.description: Optional language hint; otherwise inferred from the file extension.

target_capture.description: Capture name to treat as the anchor. Defaults to `anchor`.

indent.description: Optional indent unit override for `first_child`/`last_child` (e.g. `"  "` or `"\t"`). When unset the unit is detected from existing indentation in the file, falling back to a language default.

reindent.description: When true (default) each line of `content` is prefixed with the inferred target indentation. Set false to splice the text exactly as supplied.

dry_run.description: When true, the file is left untouched but `preview` carries the splice the call would produce.

validate.description: When true (default), the post-edit source is re-parsed and any ERROR/MISSING node aborts the edit with `result = "syntax_error"`.

session_id.description: Hostlib session id for staged-fs routing. Reads and writes consult the staged overlay when staging is active for this session.
